args.summary:
Model built and verified for a 4-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box girder bridge (35+45+45+35 m, bearing centre-lines; deck width 12.5 m, carriageway 11.5 m).

Modeling decisions:
- Idealization: 2D spine beam, linear elastic (MR-01); system = continuous_on_piers (MR-05), piers 1-3 modeled as elastic beam-columns fixed at base (MR-06).
- Girder: single-cell cast-in-place box, C50. Section integrated: A = 6.712 m², I = 4.498 m⁴ (MR-02). Ec = 34500 MPa (JTG 3362-3.1.5), γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-4.2.1). Self-weight w = 174.512 kN/m, mass m = 17.789 t/m (MR-07).
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, Ge = 1.2 MPa per manufacturer): Abutments 0 & 4 and Piers 1 & 3 = PTFE sliding, 2 per line (longitudinal free, Kh = 0); Pier 2 = plain/fixed, 2 per line (Kh = 13090.9 kN/m). Shape factors S and vertical stiffness Kv computed per JTG 3362-8.7 (e.g. S₀ = 10.10, Kv₀ = 3.614e6 kN/m; S₂ = 14.69, Kv₂ = 8.974e6 kN/m; S₁/S₃ = 13.54, Kv = 8.075e6 kN/m).
- Piers: twin 1.8 m circular columns, C40 (Ec = 32500 MPa), A = 5.089 m², I = 1.031 m⁴; heights 26 / 10 / 29 m.
- Live load: Highway Class I (JTG D60-2015), one-way, 3 lanes, ξ = 0.78, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 330 kN (35 m spans) / 350 kN (45 m spans).

Key results:
- First vertical bending frequency f1 = 2.660 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.157.
- Self-weight support reactions: 2266, 7701, 7988, 7699, 2267 kN (abutments lighter, mid pier heaviest).
- Self-weight mid-span moments 12.9-15.1 MN·m; support moments -27.5 to -30.6 MN·m.
- Lane-load max positive moment 11538.9 kN·m; max negative moment -9596.9 kN·m.

generate_model passed L1/L2/L3 checks with no issues.
